description.value:
Frequency once per scene

You see a moment from the end of this scene as it is currently headed. The GM describes one true image of how it most likely ends if no one changes course — who is standing, what is broken, what is gone. It is a projection of the present, not a fixed future, and acting on it can change it. You are also unsettled: you take a -1 status penalty to Will saves until the end of your next turn.
